ci_support_linux_64_mpimpichpython3.11._:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
fortran_compiler:
- gfortran
fortran_compiler_version:
- '15'
mpi:
- mpich
mpich:
- '4'
openmpi:
- '5'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
  - fortran_compiler_version

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: cosmosis-build-standard-library
  version: "1.3"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name | replace('-', '_') }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4be70b07dd6d557021327f30b8f8561c8e78a37c5e5201ab23968166dd408414

build:
  number: 5
  skip: ( (match(python, "<3.10")) or win )
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python
    - cosmosis
    # For compiling standard librarymodules
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ compiler("fortran") }}
    - ${{ mpi }}
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
    - bzip2
    - cfitsio
    - gsl
    - fftw
    - libblas
    - liblapack
    - camb >=1.6.5
    - make
    - numpy >=2.4
    # for running python standard library modules
    - astropy-base
    - cython
    - setuptools
    - scikit-learn
    - fast-pt
    - deepdish
    - sacc
    - scipy >=1.17

tests:
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - camb ==2.0.0
    script:
      - cosmosis-build-standard-library ${CSL_BRANCH} && cd cosmosis-standard-library && source cosmosis-configure && pytest -vv tests
      - cosmosis-build-standard-library -i ${CSL_BRANCH} && cd  `python -c 'import cosmosis;print(cosmosis.__file__)' | xargs dirname` && cd cosmosis-standard-library && cosmosis demos/demo1.ini && cosmosis-postprocess demos/demo1.ini && test -f matter_power.png
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - camb ==1.6.5
    script:
      - cosmosis-build-standard-library ${CSL_BRANCH} && cd cosmosis-standard-library && source cosmosis-configure && pytest -vv tests
      - cosmosis-build-standard-library -i ${CSL_BRANCH} && cd  `python -c 'import cosmosis;print(cosmosis.__file__)' | xargs dirname` && cd cosmosis-standard-library && cosmosis demos/demo1.ini && cosmosis-postprocess demos/demo1.ini && test -f matter_power.png

about:
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: CosmoSIS Standard Library
  description: |
    This is a meta-package providing the dependencies for the CosmoSIS Standard
    Library.
  homepage: https://github.com/joezuntz/cosmosis-standard-library
  repository: https://github.com/joezuntz/cosmosis
  documentation: https://cosmosis.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - joezuntz
    - marcpaterno
